timeline.event: Cast in Kraków by Hans Behem

tiers.everyday: The Sigismund Bell at Wawel Cathedral in Kraków was cast in 1520. It is Poland's most famous bell and is rung by hand on great occasions.
tiers.student: The cathedral gives casting in 1520 by Hans Behem of Nuremberg in Kraków, diameter 242 cm, body 9,650 kg and about 12,600 kg in all, with an original clapper of 323 kg.
